text:
**The evidence does not establish whether the owner broke the law.**

Satellite data supports tree-cover loss of 86.4 hectares on the property between 2021 and 2023, mostly in areas mapped as planted forest. But tree-cover loss can result from harvesting, fire, storms or clearing; it does not by itself establish deforestation.

The evidence also does not identify who caused the loss or whether it was authorized. Determining legality would require information about the cause, responsible party, applicable laws and any permits.
